name: Peas Pulao with Raita
steps: Rinse rice, soak for 20 minutes and drain. Thinly slice onion, thaw peas if frozen and grate cucumber for raita.
Heat ghee, sizzle cumin and cinnamon and cook onion for 7 minutes until light golden.
Add peas and drained rice and stir gently for 1 minute. Add measured water and 4 g salt, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes.
Turn off heat and rest covered for 10 minutes before fluffing. Check grains are tender; add a little boiling water and steam longer if needed.
Whisk curd with roasted cumin and remaining salt. Squeeze excess liquid from cucumber and fold it in with chopped mint.
Serve hot pulao with chilled raita alongside. Remove cinnamon before eating.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
